tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The page ground behind every card. Light, slightly warm grey; text on it is ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and rows. Separated from canvas by the ground showing through, and by line where a border is needed.

tokens.name: surface-frost
tokens.usage: Frosted panel a half-step above canvas: chart cards, the nav bar, grouped blocks inside a card.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Chips, meter and chart tracks, soft icon buttons, input fills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on surface and frost: card edges, list rules, chart baselines. Interactive borders switch to ink when active.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons everywhere (15.9:1 on surface, 14.6:1 on canvas). Also the one dark fill in the design: the primary button, the active nav pill and the arrow button.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface (6.4:1), canvas (5.9:1), surface-soft (5.5:1) and the pastels. Never on ink.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative de-emphasis inside a sentence, and disabled marks. 2.8:1: never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the ink fill (15.9:1).

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: The one card asking for attention now — the Kharcha check, a due payment. Text in ink only (14.2:1).

tokens.name: butter-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet highlight: a tip, a shared note, the second yellow in a chart. Text in ink; ink-muted allowed.

tokens.name: powder-deep
tokens.usage: The brand blue and the leading chart tone. Text in ink only (9.6:1).

tokens.name: powder
tokens.usage: Progress and goal cards, the lighter blue in a chart. Text in ink only.

tokens.name: powder-soft
tokens.usage: Palest blue: the sixth chart tone and very quiet panels. Text in ink only.

tokens.name: grey-deep
tokens.usage: Fourth chart tone and neutral fills that need to read against surface-soft. Text in ink only.

tokens.name: grey-soft
tokens.usage: Fifth chart tone and the unspent remainder in the donut.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one saturated colour: primary buttons, the plus, the active tab, selected chips. White on it is 5.4:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: The accent at chart strength: a leading bar, a selected block, a filled meter.

tokens.name: money-in
tokens.usage: Money coming in, as text only, always with a + sign and a down-left arrow (5.3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: money-out
tokens.usage: Money going out, as text only, always with a − sign and an up-right arrow (5.1:1 on surface). Never a fill, and never used to scold.

tokens.name: chart-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of a meter, bar or ring. Decorative; the printed figure carries the value.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline with a 2px offset, on every surface in the design (≥12:1 on all of them).

styles.name: text-display
styles.sample: Hello Aarav, your savings score is above average
styles.usage: Greeting headline, one per screen. Emphasise the verdict with a <strong> in weight 600.

styles.name: text-metric
styles.usage: The single big number on a progress card.

styles.name: text-title-lg
styles.usage: Month selector and sheet section headings on coral or surface.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards; icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between avatars’ neighbours.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip horizontal padding; title-to-subtitle gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter; plan-row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above a card’s action row; between header sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips' inner marks, small tiles, inputs inside a grouped block.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, nested blocks, inputs, plan items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards in a dense stack, chart blocks.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Primary cards, headers and bottom sheets. The softest corner in the design.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, toggles, avatars, icon buttons and the active nav pill.
